outcome: transfer of the neonate to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The study investigated 5616 pregnant women who gave birth between 2016 and 2023 at a maternity hospital (care level IV).
finding: Obesity class II is associated with a slightly higher risk of transfer of the neonate to a pediatric intensive care unit, but not with worse Apgar scores or pH values.
mod_finding: Overweight and obesity were accompanied by higher rates of induction of labor and elective and secondary caesarean sections.
